name: file-size
description: Cap every authored file in a repo at 5000 tokens (bytes/4), checked on commit, on push and in CI, with advice to split along deep modules.

interface.shortDescription: Cap authored files at 5000 tokens on commit, push and CI
interface.longDescription: Sets up a check in any repo that fails when an authored file passes 5000 tokens (bytes/4). Copies the script to scripts/check-file-size and wires it into lefthook pre-commit (staged files), pre-push and GitHub Actions (every tracked file), or into plain git hooks where the repo has no lefthook. Lockfiles, binaries and license texts are skipped by default; a repo adds its own globs in .file-size-excludes. A failing run explains how to split the file along a deep module, not by line count.
defaultPrompt: Use $setting-up-the-check to cap file size in this repo
Wire the file-size check into lefthook and CI here
